components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Outline Button

components.name: Destructive Button

components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { font-family: Inter, Archivo, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #DC2626; border: 1px solid #DC2626; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover, .ds-btn-destructive:focus { background: #DC2626; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF, 0 0 0 4px #DC2626; }

components.css: .ds-nav { font-family: Inter, Archivo, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; width: 256px; background: #FFFFFF; border-right: 1px solid #E7E5E4; padding: 12px 8px; } .ds-group { margin: 14px 8px 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #A8A29E; } .ds-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #57534E; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-item:hover { background: #F5F5F4; color: #1C1917; } .ds-item--active { background: #F5F3FF; color: #6D28D9; font-weight: 600; } .ds-item--active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 6px; bottom: 6px; width: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: #7C3AED; } .ds-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7C3AED; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Status Indicator
components.description: The security-status vocabulary: a filled dot with its label. Color is never the only signal.
components.html: Low Medium High Critical
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: Inter, Archivo, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; margin-right: 16px; color: #57534E; } .ds-status i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-status--low i { background: #16A34A; } .ds-status--medium i { background: #D97706; } .ds-status--high i { background: #EA580C; } .ds-status--critical i { background: #DC2626; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: A flat rounded-full pill for factual states and labels.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 10px; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid currentColor; font-family: Inter, Archivo, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-pill--brand { color: #6D28D9; background: color-mix(in srgb, #7C3AED 8%, #fff); } .ds-pill--critical { color: #DC2626; background: color-mix(in srgb, #DC2626 8%, #fff); }

narrative.overview: ReedShield is an AI Security Posture Management console for people under time pressure. It earns trust through clarity and restraint, in the register serious security products live in today: Wiz-level information clarity, Linear-level interface polish, Stripe-level cleanliness. A warm off-white ground carries crisp white cards separated by hairline borders and light shadow. Density is high and deliberate; emphasis comes from weight, size, and the security-status colors, never from glow, heavy gradient, or blur. Corners are gently rounded and a single controlled violet accent marks primary actions, selection, and active navigation. This is a clean replacement of the previous auditor's working-papers world, which is the anti-reference.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white ground (#FAFAF9) with crisp white cards; borders and light shadow separate content.
Inter for all UI text (Archivo fallback), Fragment Mono for identifiers, timestamps, and hashes.
Fixed green/amber/orange/red security-status scale plus info cyan, always paired with a label.
A controlled violet brand accent for primary actions, selection, and active navigation.
Marketing and console share the brand, type, and color system but stay visually distinct in density.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only brand accent. Severity and health use the fixed status scale, and each status color means exactly one thing across the console.

rules.name: The Labeled Status Rule
rules.body: A status dot, pill, or bar ships with a label or an accessible name. No status is color-only.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: tabular-nums is set for tables; every number aligns.

rules.name: The Restrained Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation is border-first, shadow-second. No heavy or colored shadows; reserve larger shadows for floating overlays.

dos: Do put content on white cards over the warm off-white ground, separated by 1px borders and light shadow.
Do keep the status scale meanings fixed: green low, amber medium, orange high, red critical, cyan info.
Do pair every status color with a label or accessible name.
Do keep the violet accent to primary actions, selection, and active navigation.
Do keep numerals tabular and right-aligned, and tables compact.
donts: Don't reintroduce the working-papers world: ledger-green grounds, column rulings, tick/stamp identity, square corners, or the old tab colors.
Don't reintroduce the generic default look (bright #2563eb blue, stark white, heavy floating cards) or a dark neon SOC theme.
Don't stack heavy or colored shadows, or lean on gradients and glass.
Don't use color alone for status, or a status color for decoration.
Don't use monospace for prose or buttons.
